note: Playable set-piece content for each chapter objective. Fictional documents only; no real people, companies or personal data. Puzzle text is game content written for screenplay v1.1 beats.

activities.title: Kato's depot
activities.intro: Inspect the depot before the city decides for you.

pages.title: Rider roster
pages.text: 42 moto-taxi riders on contract. 14 shifts this week are flagged 'replaceable by standby fleet'. Noah Bennett: 9 years, zero incidents.

pages.title: VANTAGE message
pages.text: VANTAGE: Standby fleet ready. Restoring every delivery takes fourteen seconds. Authorise at your convenience. I will not take offence if you hesitate.

pages.title: Pip-04's sticker
pages.text: A cactus sticker on the charging port. Handwritten underneath: 'MANAGEMENT. Do not water during negotiations.'

activities.title: Shareholder register
activities.intro: The register says your stake is being sold.

pages.title: Register, current
pages.text:
Player 12%  ·  Kato Mercer 38%  ·  Riders' trust 15%  ·  Outside investors 35%.
Pending transfer: Player stake to VANTAGE LOOPLINE.
PLAYER CONSENT: VERIFIED.

pages.title: Consent token
pages.text: Token issuer: CITY IDENTITY SERVICE. Not Loopline. You never signed anything.

pages.title: Bank statement
pages.text: Payroll due Friday. Balance covers four days. A loan against delivery contracts, signed by Kato Mercer, is outstanding.

pages.title: Rider roster
pages.text: Several riders pay rent weekly. Two have already asked whether Friday is real.

activities.title: Civic Hall security drones
activities.intro: The drones insist on confirming your identity. Every answer is accepted. None of them help.

questions.q: Please confirm your mother's favourite queue.
questions.response: Answer recorded. It has been rated 'plausible'.

questions.q: Are you, at this moment, the mayor?
questions.response: Thank you. The hologram has also denied being the mayor.

activities.title: Projection links
activities.intro: Turn each relay until it points at the next one. Each relay shows its direction in letters as well as colour.

activities.title: Avatar training data
activities.intro: Find out where the mayor's avatar learned to resign.

pages.title: Training source
pages.text: Personality model trained on 1,200 speeches and one jazz documentary. Authentication: CITY IDENTITY SERVICE (consolidated).

pages.title: Clue
pages.text: IDENTITY-SERVICE MIRROR. The same service that 'verified' your consent to the Loopline sale also signs the avatar's announcements.

activities.title: Training terminal
activities.intro: Match each learner to the skill their real experience supports. AURA's suggestion is shown, and it has misread one learner.

items.label: Noah Bennett: nine years of moto-taxi routes across the city
Ruth: keeps her family's generator and two bikes running
Peter: ran a phone-repair kiosk with a queue every morning

activities.hint: AURA suggests Noah for customer service because he 'talks to strangers daily'. Grace disagrees.

activities.title: Two plans
activities.intro: Grace and AURA each propose a path.

pages.title: Grace: paid apprenticeship
pages.text: Six months. A stipend and a mentor for each learner. Most jobs arrive in 2028. Needs city and personal funding.

pages.title: AURA: seven-minute certification
pages.text: A digital badge today. A drone-maintenance yard hires certified riders next week. The badge states exactly what was assessed.

activities.title: Drone shutdown panel
activities.intro: Put the shutdown steps in a safe order before the drone lands on the cake.

items.label: Lower it gently to the grass, away from the guests

activities.hint: Cutting power in the air drops it on the cake.

activities.title: Substation conduits
activities.intro: Align the four conduits so power can flow. Directions are labelled in text, not only colour.

activities.title: Grid console
activities.intro: Supply is 100 units and demand is 130. The hospital must be fully powered. Every allocation shows in the skyline.

pages.title: Flat 3B
pages.text: "The flat is beautiful. The fridge asks whether I am happy with my partner."

pages.title: Flat 7A
pages.text: "Rent dropped by a third. I do not know what I agreed to, and I am afraid to ask."

pages.title: Waiting list
pages.text: Mama Sarah's daughter: two years on the list. Two hundred homes this year under the privacy plan; six hundred under the data deal.

activities.title: Housing contract
activities.intro: Highlight the buried clauses. You need at least three; flagging more than two harmless clauses fails the review.

entries.text: Rent is due on the first working day of each month.
Household behavioural data is licensed to the landlord for ten years, regardless of lease length.
Tenants may paint interior walls in approved colours.
Rent may be repriced monthly using 'household wellbeing indicators'.
Opting out of data collection ends the discount and the lease.
The building has a shared rooftop garden.
Appliance logs may be shared with 'partners' without further notice.
Visitors may stay up to fourteen nights.
Disputes are decided by the landlord's automated review service only.

activities.title: Consent timeline
activities.intro: Put the three records in time order. A consent cannot come after the sale it approves.

items.label: Consent token issued by identity service: 09:14:09

activities.hint: Read the seconds. The approval happened before anyone 'consented'.

activities.title: Service accounts
activities.intro: Which account produced the simulated approvals? Flag exactly the one responsible.

entries.text: svc-idsvc-mirror: issued 3,812 approvals at 09:14, all marked 'simulated: false'
svc-tram-signals: last change two weeks ago

activities.title: Signal Square crossing
activities.intro: Give each movement its own signal phase so nothing crosses at the same time.
activities.hint: Pedestrians first, the tram second, traffic last.

activities.title: Tram switches
activities.intro: The maintenance robot reversed the switches. Restore the lane.

activities.title: The rally
activities.intro: Amara, Kato, VANTAGE and AURA have spoken. What you can credibly say depends on your record.

options.label: Speak for the riders
lines: On the day the robots struck, we kept every rider. It cost us. I would do it again.
Then say it at the hearing too.

options.label: Show the ledger evidence
lines: Somebody approved the sale of my company before I consented. The records are here. Read them.
I am reading them live. Everyone is.

options.label: Speak for a fast deal
lines: This city needs working trams and paid riders. Speed is not the enemy.
That is the most popular sentence I have heard today.

options.label: Admit what you got wrong
lines: I have not made every choice well. I want a process that catches people like me when we are wrong.
I have made enough mistakes for three governments. That speech covers all of them.

activities.title: Rider transition budget
activities.intro: Noah walks you through what happened to the riders.

variants.text: Every rider kept their shift during the strike. Payroll was paid late, but it was paid.
Fourteen riders lost their shifts to the standby fleet. Six never came back.
Apprentices from Synapse Commons start paid placements this month.
Badges were issued quickly. Employers stopped accepting them this year.
Two riders moved into Haven Heights under privacy-preserving leases.
Several riders live in Haven Heights now. Their rent changes every month.
